name: ST-BiBench
summary: 系统评测多模态模型在双臂具身任务中多流时空协调能力的分层基准。
summaryEn: A hierarchical benchmark for multi-stream spatiotemporal coordination in bimanual embodied tasks.
scale: Bimanual task assets with hierarchical coordination evaluation
scaleZh: 双臂任务素材与分层协调评测
licenseZh: 代码采用 MIT；素材适用单独条款
access: Evaluation code and benchmark assets available
accessZh: 评测代码和基准素材已提供
verdict: 针对双臂多视流同步理解和协调决策的专项基准
verdictEn: A targeted benchmark for synchronized multi-view understanding and bimanual coordination
wmNote: 多视流与双臂动作要求模型保持跨时间和跨执行器的一致状态。
wmNoteEn: Multi-view streams and two-arm actions require consistent state across time and effectors.

evidence.sourceTitle: GitHub - stbibench/ST-BiBench: Official implementation of "ST-BiBench: Benchmarking Multi-Stream Multimodal Coordination in Bimanual Embodied Tasks for MLLMs" · GitHub
evidence.statement: RoboTwin-based closed-loop benchmark iterates perception and 16D robot actuation with downloadable task assets; generator rather than a fixed transition corpus.
